requirements.summary: Replace all user-facing occurrences of the old page name “public clue-by-url” with “Echofields”, including navigation text and document/page titles, without breaking routing.
acceptanceCriteria: No user-facing UI text contains the phrase "public clue-by-url".
User-facing page name text reads "Echofields" consistently (e.g., headers/navigation/page heading/title where applicable).
Navigation to the renamed page still works and does not introduce routing errors.

file_operations.description: Update the document <title> to use “Echofields” (and remove any remaining “Public clue-by-URL”/legacy naming) so the browser tab title reflects the renamed public page.
Ensure the Home page sets an appropriate document title including “Echofields” (e.g., base title) to satisfy page-title rename expectations without altering routing behavior.
Set a route-appropriate document title that includes “Echofields” (e.g., “Echofields — Clue #<id>”) and verify no legacy name remains in any user-facing strings on this page.
Set a document title including “Echofields” for the spectate/admin portal views and confirm no legacy page name appears in headings, labels, or helper text.
